caseStudies.title: Arpanex: Brand Identity and Website, Built From Scratch
description: Arpanex came to us as a fresh business with no existing brand or website. We built both from the ground up — a complete visual identity paired with a fully custom, responsive marketing site.
Every page was designed and engineered in-house, giving Arpanex a professional presence ready to support its launch.
caseStudies.role: Brand Identity, UI/UX Design & Web Development

overview.title: About the Arpanex Project
overview.text: Arpanex came to us as a brand new business — no name recognition, no visual identity, no website. We handled the full build end-to-end, from the first logo sketch to the final deployed site.

points.text: logo, color system, and typography built from scratch.
designed and coded in-house, not templated.
built mobile-first from day one.
brand and site shipped together as one cohesive package.

challenge.title: Where It Got Difficult
challenge.text: Starting a brand from absolute zero means there's no existing foundation to build on — every choice carries more weight because nothing exists yet to fall back on.

points.text: every visual decision had to be made from a blank page.
information architecture had to be defined before any design work could start.

points.lead: Brand and website had to launch together
points.text: leaving no room for the two to drift apart or feel disconnected.

solution.title: How We Solved It
solution.text: We treated brand and website as one connected project instead of two separate handoffs, so every decision on one side informed the other.

points.text: before any screen was designed, to keep the visual identity intentional.
so the website could scale beyond the first set of pages.
identity and UI evolved together instead of in isolation.

caseStudies.impact: Arpanex launched with a cohesive brand and a fast, fully responsive website built to grow alongside the business.

caseStudies.title: Echovyn: A Distinct Visual Identity
description: Echovyn needed a visual identity that stood apart in a crowded market. We designed a complete brand system — logo, color language, and design guidelines — built to carry across every touchpoint.
The result is an identity Echovyn can apply consistently, from their website to future marketing materials.

overview.title: About the Echovyn Project
overview.text: Echovyn needed a visual identity that could stand on its own in a market full of similar-looking competitors — this was a brand design engagement from the ground up.

points.text: logo, color palette, and typography designed as one cohesive set.
so the brand stays consistent as it's applied elsewhere.
not just a logo, but a system ready for web and marketing.

challenge.title: Where It Got Difficult
challenge.text: Standing out visually is easy to say and hard to do — especially without straying from what the business actually is.

points.text: many competitors already use similar colors and styles.
nothing to build on, so direction had to be established from scratch.
standing out without becoming something the business isn't.

solution.title: How We Solved It
solution.text: We explored multiple directions before committing, testing each against what actually represents the business rather than picking the most visually loud option.

points.text: explored before narrowing to one direction.
not just aesthetics for their own sake.
for consistent use across every future touchpoint.

caseStudies.impact: Echovyn now has a cohesive, distinct visual identity ready to apply across their website and future brand touchpoints.

caseStudies.title: Nyrly: Point-of-Sale Software for Retail
description: Nyrly is a point-of-sale platform for retail businesses. We designed and built the product experience — from checkout flow to inventory management — focused on speed and ease of use for busy store staff.
The result is a POS system that feels simple at the counter while handling the operational complexity behind the scenes.

overview.title: About the Nyrly Project
overview.text: Nyrly set out to build a modern point-of-sale platform for retail businesses — we partnered on both product design and development.

points.text: checkout, inventory, and reporting in one connected system.
built around real store-floor conditions, not a demo environment.
architecture designed to support growing stores, not just a single location.

challenge.title: Where It Got Difficult
challenge.text: Retail checkout software has almost no margin for friction — staff need it to be fast, and it still has to manage real inventory and sales data underneath.

points.text: any extra click at checkout costs time during busy hours.

points.lead: Low tolerance for a learning curve
points.text: staff needed to use it correctly with minimal training.

points.lead: Inventory accuracy had to hold up
points.text: under real-world usage, not just controlled testing.

solution.title: How We Solved It
solution.text: We designed the interface around speed first, then built the systems underneath to support it without slowing anything down.

points.text: designed around the most common actions first.
so nothing has to be reconciled manually.
not hours, so new staff can use it immediately.

caseStudies.impact: Nyrly now has a POS product built for real-world retail use, ready to support stores as they grow.

caseStudies.title: Vediq Care: Clinic Management, Simplified
description: Vediq Care is a clinic management platform built to help healthcare practices run day-to-day operations — appointments, patient records, and scheduling — from one place.
We designed and built the product to feel straightforward for clinic staff, without sacrificing the depth a healthcare workflow needs.

overview.title: About the Vediq Care Project
overview.text: Vediq Care needed a clinic management platform that clinic staff could actually use day-to-day, not just a feature checklist.

points.lead: Appointments and records in one place
points.text: no switching between separate tools.
built for clinic teams, not IT departments.
scheduling, records, and coordination in one system.

challenge.title: Where It Got Difficult
challenge.text: Clinic operations involve a lot of moving parts, and healthcare software has to organize all of it without becoming overwhelming to use.

points.text: scheduling, records, and staff coordination all had to work together.
clinic staff needed clarity, not a learning curve, during patient care.
had to be organized carefully and handled with care.

solution.title: How We Solved It
solution.text: We designed the platform around the clinic's actual daily workflow instead of a generic feature list, keeping the most common actions simple.

points.text: built around how a clinic actually operates day to day.
appointments, records, and operations under one roof.
so staff can focus on patients, not the software.

caseStudies.impact: Vediq Care now has a clinic management platform built around how clinics actually work day-to-day.
